description: Read a Base token name, symbol, decimals and total supply in one call. Handles tokens that return a bytes32 name or symbol instead of a string, which is the case that breaks naive decoders. Fields the contract does not implement come back null and are listed, rather than guessed at. Refuses an address with no contract. Pay 6000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.
name: base_token_metadata
title: Base Token Metadata
